records.readable_german: ZUPORTPAT487LEO. Gokieloff, Gokieloff, ist wegen Krankheit vom Mil. Gouv. CZENNTOCHAU mit Durchreiseschein nach Georgien zurueckgesandt.
records.title: Gokieloff sent back to Georgia; instruction not to transmit money
records.meaning: The proposed body says the person written Gokieloff was sent back to Georgia because of illness, with a transit permit from the military governor at the literal place CZENNTOCHAU. Both occurrences of the surname are already directly read. The opening ZUPORTPAT487LEO is retained as an opaque label, and the place spelling is not normalized or mapped to a modern location.
records.reading_note: The source prints DAAXQ, with a genuine noncoordinate Q at 54. One source-mask fill completes NACH. A separate enlargement resolves XFVVF with a final F, not the initial low-resolution T reading, so it is not counted as an erasure. Four observed-coordinate substitutions separately repair 9ST, KRAIKHEIT and DDRCH, and propose separator X for the final E after GESANDT. 487 and the literal opening and place fields are unchanged.

records.meaning: The second part instructs that no money be transmitted. The closing reads Heeresgr. Kiew, with the literal labels 1C and HRW8536. Those labels are not changed to a presumed staff branch or number prefix.
